'''Ramsid Almadar''' was the brother of King [[Alsalam]] of [[Arad Doman]] and was one of [[Graendal|Graendal's]] pets.{{ref/book|twotc|Ramsid Almadar}} He was good-looking and coppery-skinned with dark hair{{ref/book|6|6}}.

==Activities==

With his wife, his sister and his niece he performed for Graendal and [[Sammael]]{{ref/book|6|6}}.

As with all of the people living inside [[Natrin's Barrow]], Ramsid probably died when it was balefired by [[Rand]]{{ref/book|12|37}}.
